constraints.statement: Treat the split failure as systemic until the complete producer, lifecycle-authority, routing, delivery, retry, publication, recovery, and terminal-consumer cone plus its git history is explicit; implement only after the contradiction and every involved owner are recorded.

ManagedSplitWorkflow remains the sole split lifecycle authority and owns exactly one subordinate split-cutover-handoff-closure interaction decision; PartitionService, readiness/publication, routing, QueryExecutor, and DistributedWriteCoordinator contribute typed evidence or consume the decision but never become parallel retirement authorities.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

A real CLEANUP_COMPLETED acknowledgement with own-data sourceMirrorRemoved:false persists replay progress but can never authorize source replica removal, source descriptor deletion, or terminal split completion; inherited, accessor, missing, malformed, stale-fence, and duplicate evidence fail closed.

Source retirement requires a durable versioned proof that the target partition epoch is authoritative, both children are write-and-serve routable, replay is drained, and every active query plane has crossed an in-flight-safe target-epoch observation boundary; local child rows or one observer's readiness are insufficient.

Publication, readiness, routing, and relevant CDC changes re-arm the same owner-key reconcile decision; do not add arbitrary sleeps, widen query/loader retry, broaden CDC redrive, or create a second retirement timer/authority.

Preserve durable affectedRows deletion proof, lease and fence validation, exact-once teardown, abort safety, split/merge overlap exclusion, durable replay cursor, sibling epoch promotion, and merge lifecycle semantics.

Closure requires a fresh exact-source GCP A/B with N>=2 fixed and N>=2 exact aggregate revert runs under concurrent write load; the fixed arm must prove publication/handoff engagement and strict source-retirement ordering with zero source Partition service not found, child planning_snapshot_refresh_pending terminal failures, or duplicate dissolution.
Run only narrow focused deterministic checks locally while monitoring CPU and SSD temperature; run broad, long-running, large, and live cluster validation in GCP.
